blocks.prompt: 4 (i) Find the indicated term of the arithmetic sequence: \(a_1 = 3,\ d = 7,\ a_{14}\) [printed as \(a_{14} = 14\)]
blocks.explanation:
Humein ek khaas term chahiye, yani 14th term, aur saari terms likhe baghair.
\(a_1\) aur \(d\) seedhe diye hain.
Plan: general term \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) mein \(n = 14\) rakh dena.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_1 = 3,\ d = 7\)
Humein find karna hai: \(a_{14}\).
Tareeqa: A.P. ki general term \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\). Yeh formula is liye kaam karta hai ke \(n\)th term tak pohanchne ke liye \(a_1\) mein \((n - 1)\) dafa \(d\) jama hota hai.

Values rakh kar simplify karein
\[a_{14} = 3 + (14 - 1)(7)\]
\[= 3 + 13 \times 7\]
\[= 3 + 91 = 94\]
Kyun: Pehli term se 14th term tak 13 qadam hain (jaise seedhi ki pehli seedhi se 14th tak 13 qadam), is liye 13 dafa 7 jama hua.
Dhyan dein: \(14 \times 7\) lagana, yani \(n\) dafa \(d\), sab se aam ghalti hai. Hamesha \((n - 1)\) dafa.

Tasdeeq: ek qadam pehle se
\[a_{13} = 3 + 12(7) = 87\]
\[a_{14} = 87 + 7 = 94 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 14th term 13th term se bilkul ek qadam aage hai, is liye 87 mein 7 jama kiya. Jawab wohi aaya.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein \(a_{14} = 14\) chhapa hai. Yeh 14 ghalti se chhap gaya hai: \(a_{14}\) to wohi term hai jo humein nikaalni hai. \(a_1 = 3\) aur \(d = 7\) se \(a_{14} = 94\) banta hai, aur answer key mein bhi 94 hi hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (ii) Find the indicated term of the arithmetic sequence: \(8, 3, -2, \ldots,\ a_{12}\)
blocks.explanation:
Is part mein \(a_1\) aur \(d\) seedhe nahi diye; humein list se khud parhne hain.
Find kya karna hai? 12th term, yani \(a_{12}\).
Plan: \(a_1 = 8\), \(d = 3 - 8\), phir general term mein \(n = 12\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(8, 3, -2, \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(a_{12}\).
Tareeqa: List ki pehli term \(a_1\) hai, aur kisi bhi term mein se us se pehli term minus karein to \(d\) mil jata hai. Phir general term ka formula.

Pehli term aur common difference
\[a_1 = 8\]
\[d = 3 - 8 = -5\]
\[-2 - 3 = -5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Terms 8 se 3, phir 3 se \(-2\) ho rahi hain, yani har dafa 5 kam. Is liye \(d\) negative hai: \(-5\). Do jore check kiye taake yakeen ho ke A.P. hai.
Dhyan dein: \(d = 8 - 3 = 5\) likhna ghalat hai; hamesha baad wali term minus pehli term.

Values rakh kar simplify karein
\[a_{12} = 8 + (12 - 1)(-5)\]
\[= 8 - 55 = -47\]
Kyun: 11 qadam, har qadam \(-5\): kul \(-55\). 8 se 55 neeche jayein to \(-47\) aata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[a_3 = 8 + 2(-5) = -2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula ne list ki di hui teesri term \(-2\) wapas di, matlab \(a_1\) aur \(d\) sahi hain, to \(a_{12}\) bhi sahi hai.
